messages:
Maya: Quick thread to finalize scope for the Optimize toolkit pilot. Main ask: agree on what we gate during canary and what stays advisory (quant recs). Short plan: discovery week -> 10-day canary -> decision.
Jordan: +1. Need explicit SLOs and a telemetry contract before canary. Will productize dashboards.
Sanjay: Runtime: prefer Dedicated-first for batch+cache. Need per-tenant safe-mode and an explicit KV invalidate API. Also request to keep embeddings out of quant in the pilot.
Lee: Ops telemetry contract (min): events: batch_start, batch_flush, cache_hit, cache_miss, quant_suggest, eval_alert; metrics: p50/p95 latency, token_cost_est, cache_hit_ratio, eval_concordance. Tag dims: customer_id, route, model_variant.
Alex: Proposed safety gates:
- eval_concordance_drop <= 2% absolute on safety suite
- customer_error_rate delta <= 0.4%
- no P1 incidents in canary window
Benefit goals (promote if safety passes + >=1):
- token_cost reduction >= 12% for batched flows
- median latency not worse for low-latency routes
Maya: Customer tranche: 4 opt-in customers (enterprise, mid, startup, internal). Traffic ramp: 1% -> 5% -> 15% with 48h holdpoints.
Jordan: Dashboards: per-route latency, cost-per-token, batch size distribution, cache hit ratio, eval diff samples. I'll draft widgets.
Sanjay: Canary config sketch:
```
optkit:
  batching:
    max_batch_ms: 12
    max_batch_size: 64
  cache:
    kv_prefix_ttl_s: 300
    explicit_invalidate: true
  quant:
    mode: advisory
```
Lee: Rollback policy: auto-rollback if eval_alert severity >= P2 or user_error_rate > 0.5% for 5 minutes. Ops will implement circuit and runbook. Keep eval traces 30 days.
deploy-bot: Canary slot reserved: canary-3168 (start: 2026-12-01T14:00Z).
Maya: Next steps: Alex owns eval runs/reporting, Sanjay implements safe-mode & invalidate API, Jordan wires dashboards, Lee builds rollback circuits, I'll handle customer outreach. Reconvene after discovery.
Alex: Will add nightly diff job and share first report next Mon.
All: 👍
